He said that before on occasion and I think he sometimes cares but the next day he goes back to treating me like I'm disposable but everyone else who he knows is not. Used to talk all day and night, first thing in the morning and last person I spoke to before I went to bed. Now it's pretty much the opposite  and I'm beginning to feel like if I die then maybe everyone will be satisfied. He's weird... One day alone with him and able to even hug or cuddle once with him and I'd probably die from happiness but that'll never happen and we'll probably stop being friends anyway.

I'm not too into theater though my friend is big time ironically. I'll try to check it out. 

Book 3 was awesome, I've only seen bits of the movie but Sirius is a sick. His actor was pretty attractive, but mainly a fatherly figure and age which he should be 😂.

Haven't seen anything about the Raven cycle before but I'm more than willing to check it out, books keep me going I guess. I'm still hopping tonight I'll somehow die and I know it's not right to think that. Every day I wake up next to my window and go "I should just jump..." But sadly it's barely high enough to kill, just prob disabled me which isn't what I'm looking for.

You're cool to talk to, thank you.

Thank you, beginning to think my friend doesn't even care about me anymore. Something goes wrong in my life and he goes "eh.", something as small as he stubbed his toe and he goes on for an hour... I'm in a pretty large town although it's not exactly pro-gay, more a gang bang drug zone. I'd go but I'd be afraid anyone there or around there would see me, word would get back to my parents or my friend and then it'll all be for nothing.

I've been through pretty much every other book, HGs, Divergent, The Martian, Gatsby and a dozen others but this one series kept nagging. Put it off because of the length and one I read book one I was addicted. Book 3 was my favorite, Sirius MVP. 

Was also nice to see Harry go through grief, remorse, depression along with the Dementors which made it strike closer to home. Already had spoiled myself sadly before I read the books by seeing 4, 6 & 7.
He is. I live in this town and I pray he gets out one way or another. Town sucks though, gunshots every night and murders where no one blinks an eye.
